name: Prasugrel
dosing: Loading 60mg, then 10mg daily (consider 5mg daily in elderly/low body weight per guidance); used per ACS/PCI protocols
contraindications: History of stroke/TIA, active pathological bleeding
monitoring: Signs of bleeding, Hb and platelets
pregnancy: Use only if benefit outweighs risk
clinicalPearls: Preferentially used in PCI populations; avoid in prior stroke/TIA
indication: ACS patients undergoing PCI (per cardiology guidance)
